name: Wikisource (français)
legal: Bibliothèque libre de la Wikimedia Foundation : textes du domaine public ou sous licence libre, exportés en EPUB par l'outil officiel WS Export.
notes: 2026-10-31: disabled. ws-export.wmcloud.org is now behind Anubis bot protection (even robots.txt answers a challenge page), so neither we nor the app can download its EPUBs (issue #9). Replaced by beq. If WS Export opens again to robots, the daily canary opens a source-candidate-ok issue: then re-verify (AGENTS.md P1a). The official WS Export tool publishes one OPDS file per wiki category: fr/Bon_pour_export.xml lists the works the French community marked ready for export (about 9 MB). Harvested weekly. check_download is off because each EPUB is generated on demand (slow, ~30 s) and we must not load WS Export for a health check.
